review_type: independent static and decoded animation-frame visual QA

scope.static: Final light/dark contacts, native192x208 paired decoded frames, magnified legs; rechecked final right-row pixels after cuff fix.
scope.dynamic: Decoded and visually inspected all8 paired WebP frames in order, including8→1. No actual real-time playback or Codex native client observed.
scope.prior_verdicts: No absolute or prior-generation pass/fail inherited. Final atlas hash verified.

proportions.evidence: Left/right both retain round broad cheeks, large head and short plump torso beside canonical at native192x208. Left is no longer conspicuously thin; head/body remain stable across own8 frames.

opposite_leg_phase.evidence: Right1 foreground thigh/boot sits forward(screen-right) from its hip, far leg trails left; right5 foreground swings back(left), far swings forward(right), partly overlapping. Left1 foreground leg swings forward(left) while far swings right and boots overlap; left5 foreground swings back(right), far swings forward(left) with separated boots. Motion JSON inspected only as secondary confirmation of those visible changes.

two_legs_two_feet.evidence: All16 candidate poses have two leg chains/two boots; overlap hides the far boot in some phases, with no third independent boot observed.

weapon_and_hat.evidence: Right one bow and arrowhead screen-right; left one bow at screen-left glove with right glove drawing at chest, arrowhead left. Knot stays screen-left and bent tip screen-right in both directions; no whole-pig mirror defect.

hip_knee_seams.evidence: Final right broad rectangular pink flap is gone in frames4–6. No detached knee/boot or transparent crack through connected leg observed. Left4–6 inner trouser edge and right4–6 outer cuff retain small1–2px pointed cloth corners at magnification; native192 size reads as cloth edge, not major tear.

loop_continuity.evidence: Eight distinct successive short-step poses; first and last are neighboring swing states, no extra final hold, stable upper body and no conspicuous framewise scale pop. Timing-sensitive judder/sliding not certified without playback.

palette.evidence: No conspicuous within-row color outlier in hat, cheeks, trousers, wings or gold on both backgrounds; directional lighting differences remain.

minor_warnings: Small rigid-layer cloth edge points at1–2px and overlapping boots during passing poses.
Short-step motion is mechanically bounded; actual real-time foot planting/sliding and naturalness remain unobserved.
handoff_limits: Suitable for user preview under observed static/frame sequence scope.
